messages:
lina-partners: Quick sync — AWS Marketplace + AcmeCloud asked for a trimmed reference architecture + Terraform module set for private & dedicated deployments. They want example templates, packaging instructions, and a small sample app by next Tue. Who can own?
matt-eng: I can take the Terraform modules. Plan: base module for vpc/subnets, module for dedicated GPU pool, module for redwood-connect (private control plane). Need compatibility matrix for ami/instance types.
suzanne-arch: I'll own the refarch doc. Target: 1 page diagram + deployment steps for both VPC and on‑prem. Will include network ports, KMS flow, and example rollout policy.
olivia-docs: I'll draft the marketplace packaging guide and checklist (listing required metadata, entitlements, support contact, images). Can someone paste the minimal terraform example to include? :pray:
raj-field: @matt-eng here's the tiny snippet we used in the PoC, strip out org specifics:
```hcl
module "redwood_dedicated" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/terraform-modules//dedicated"
  region = "us-west-2"
  gpu_count = 4
  instance_type = "c7g.4xlarge"
  vpc_id = module.vpc.id
}
```
matt-eng: perfect. I'll create a minimal example repo under partners/refarch-aws. Will add CI that runs `terraform fmt` and `validate` in GH actions.
lina-partners: timeline check — is sample app + modules + refarch doc realistic by Tue EOD?
suzanne-arch: yes for initial drafts. Need review cycle: Eng review (matt), Security review (raj), Docs review (olivia).
raj-field: security checklist: KMS key policy example, subnet isolation, S3 bucket policies for model artifacts, and audit log wiring. I'll send a short template.
olivia-docs: I'll put a docs PR template with a docs checklist (screenshots, diagrams, example commands, troubleshooting FAQs).
dev-bot: Deploy preview for partners/refarch-aws created: https://preview.redwood.dev/partners/refarch-aws/PR-12 (expires in 3 days)
matt-eng: FYI: need to call out supported quantization profiles in module README — some instance types need different drivers. Adding a section.
lina-partners: Ownership summary: matt-eng = terraform modules & example repo, suzanne-arch = refarch diagram + security scenario, raj-field = security checklist + partner SOC questions, olivia-docs = marketplace packaging + docs PR template. I'll coordinate partner reviews and schedule a 30m demo next Wed.
suzanne-arch: I'll drop the first draft diagram here by EOD today.
matt-eng: starting repo now, will ping when GH org + branch created.
olivia-docs: added initial marketplace checklist draft in /docs/marketplace-checklist.md — will link in PR.
lina-partners: nice. One more ask from AcmeCloud: provide instructions for private telemetry (audit logs only, masked PII). raj — can you write the sample log config?
raj-field: on it. Will add an example fluentbit config and a short note on retention/export.
lina-partners: thanks team. Quick TODOs: 1) matt create repo + module skeleton (today) 2) suzanne diagram (today) 3) raj security templates (tomorrow) 4) olivia packaging doc (tomorrow) 5) sync demo with partner (Wed). Mark blockers here. :thumbsup:
matt-eng: blocker — need AMI builds for c7g images from infra. @eng-infra do we have a Packer pipeline?
raj-field: pinging infra in #eng-infra, but we can include generic AMI note for now.
dev-bot: Reminder: weekly partnerships check-in in 2 days.
lina-partners: Great — I'll update partner and confirm demo slot. If anything slips, call it out in this thread. Thanks all!
